1. Hospital Overview
Chennai. Established in 1998, the hospital provides comprehensive medical care across 18 clinical
departments and is accredited by NABH (National Accreditation Board for Hospitals) and NABL (for
laboratory services).
The hospital operates 24 hours a day, 365 days a year for emergency and inpatient services.
Outpatient (OPD) services run six days a week, Monday to Saturday. The campus spans 4.5 acres
and includes a main hospital block, a diagnostic wing, a dedicated maternity

campus spans 4.5 acres
and includes a main hospital block, a diagnostic wing, a dedicated maternity and child care block, and
a 24-hour pharmacy.
Key facts:
• Established: 1998
• Total beds: 350 (including 48 ICU beds and 20 NICU beds)
• Operation theatres: 8 modular operation theatres
• Clinical departments: 18
• Full-time consultants: 62 | Visiting consultants: 35
• Nursing staff: 410 | Support staff: 280
• Accreditations: NABH, NABL
• Average OPD footfall: approximately 900 patients per day

Mission & Vision
Mission: To deliver safe, affordable, and compassionate healthcare to every patient. Vision: To be the
most trusted healthcare provider in South India by 2030, combining clinical excellence with
patient-centred service.

public holidays.

• Number of emergency beds: 15 (including 4 resuscitation bays)

10. Appointment Booking Process
Appointments can be booked through any of the following channels:
• Phone: Call +91-44-4000-1234 (appointment desk, 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM, Mon–Sat)
• Online: www.sunrisehospital.example/appointments — select department, doctor, date, and slot
• Mobile app: 'Sunrise Health' app (Android and iOS)
• WhatsApp: Message 'Hi' to +91-98400-11223 and follow the menu
• In person: Registration counters, Ground Floor, Block A (7:30 AM – 7:00 PM)
Steps for online booking
• Step 1:

Registration counters, Ground Floor, Block A (7:30 AM – 7:00 PM)
Steps for online booking
• Step 1: Visit the website or app and choose 'Book Appointment'.
• Step 2: Select the department (e.g., Cardiology) and preferred doctor.
• Step 3: Pick an available date and time slot.
• Step 4: Enter patient name, age, mobile number, and UHID (if already registered).
• Step 5: Pay the consultation fee online or choose 'Pay at hospital'.
• Step 6: A confirmation SMS with a token number is sent to the reg

ine or choose 'Pay at hospital'.
• Step 6: A confirmation SMS with a token number is sent to the registered mobile.
New patients are issued a Unique Hospital ID (UHID) at first registration; a one-time registration fee
of I 100 applies. Appointments can be rescheduled or cancelled up to 2 hours before the slot via the
same channel. Fees paid online for cancelled appointments are refunded within 5–7 working days.
